methodology.ma: Close > MA5 > MA10 > MA20: 多头; reverse: 空头; otherwise 震荡. At least 20 bars.
methodology.macd: DIF=EMA12-EMA26; DEA=EMA9(DIF); histogram=2*(DIF-DEA). EMA seeded with first close, DEA with 0. 金叉/死叉 only on latest crossover, otherwise 偏多/偏空 by DIF vs DEA. At least 26 bars; fewer than 60 flagged as limited initialization history.
methodology.rsi: Wilder RSI14; first 14 changes seed mean gain/loss; subsequent (previous*13+change)/14. Flat=50. <=30 超卖; >=70 超买; 30..50 偏弱; 50..70 偏强.
methodology.aggregation: Week uses Monday-Sunday; month uses calendar month. Each period uses its own closes. Current incomplete week/month is provisional; completion flag is conservative (Friday/calendar month end), not an exchange holiday calendar.
methodology.sources: Uses each cached series as returned, qfqday where available else day. Not standardized across adjustment bases; check per-record priceSeries. Cash and OTC bond funds excluded.
